blocks.text:
1) Load the data from MARS Oracle data base into IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_SRC_BASE.MARS_ATD_F_HB_PSG for source type PSG and into IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_SRC_BASE.MARS_ATD_HB_NON_PSG for source type NON_PSG. Repeat the same process for other sites.
2) Transform into IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_SRC.MARS_ATD_F_HB_PSG for PSG and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_SRC.MARS_ATD_F_HB_NON_PSG for NON PSG. Repeat the same process for other sites.
3) Transform it again into XFRM Layer. IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_MARS_ATD_F_HB_PSG for PSG and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_MARS_ATD_F_HB_NON_PSG for NON PSG. Repeat the same process for other sites.
4) Union all the XFRM Layer PSG data into the Stage view - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_PSG_STAGE and the XFRM Layer Non PSG data into stage view - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_NON_PSG_STAGE. 
5) Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_PSG_STAGE with  PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT where SUBJECT_AREA_NM= 'InboundMARS' and ENTITY_NM= 'HBLoader' AND BUSINESS_RULE_NM= 'HBLoaderSchema' AND ColumnLabelOneTxt = 'SourceType' AND ColumnLabelFourxt = 'LocationId'  AND ColumnLabelFourxt = 'ViewForSource' to create a column 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM' for PSG. Add a column "MAIN_CELL_DESC" and keep it as blank.
6) Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_NON_PSG_STAGE with  PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT where SUBJECT_AREA_NM= 'InboundMARS' and ENTITY_NM= 'HBLoader' AND BUSINESS_RULE_NM= 'HBLoaderSchema' AND ColumnLabelOneTxt = 'SourceType' AND ColumnLabelFourxt = 'ViewForSource' to create a column 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM' for PSG.  Add a column "MAIN_CELL_DESC" and keep it as blank.
7) For Import Flag, Join IMPORT_FLAG_IND from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_NON_PSG_STAGE and IMPORT_FLAG_IND from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_NON_PSG_STAGE with  PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT where  ColumnLabelThreeTxt = 'ImportFlag' to toggle whether to import that site's data into the Stage view. If "Y" then bring the site's data in the stage view. If "N" then don't
8) Join SHOP_FLOOR_PRODUCT_ITEM_DSC from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_PSG_STAGE with SHOP_FLOOR_PRODUCT_NM from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANNING_ITEM_SHOP_FLOOR_PRODUCT_ASSOCIATION_CORE_PIT to bring out PLANNING_ITEM_ID.
9) Join PACKAGE_DEVICE_REVISION_STEP_TEXT from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_NON_PSG_STAGE on concatenated PACKAGE_DEVICE_REVISION_STEP_TEXT (Concatenate columns MFG_PKG_CODE, MANUFACTURING_DEVICE_NAME,INTERNAL_REVISION, INTERNAL_STEPPING)  from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_DENORMALIZED_CORE_PIT to bring out ITEM_ID.
10) Join with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_MAPPING_CORE_PIT on ITEM_ID = PROC_ITEM_ID from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_DENORMALIZED_CORE_PIT to bring out UPI Items
11) Join with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT on LOCATION_ID = MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_PSG_STAGE and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_NON_PSG_STAGE and bring out the relevant Manufacturing Codes in LOCATION_ID column
12) Union IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_PSG_STAGE and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_NON_PSG_STAGE to have Stage view - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HB_LOADER_SUBCELL_CORE_STAGE
13) Time Travel the Stage view to CORE_CURRENT and CORE_MEMORIES to form the CORE_PIT view - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_HB_LOADER_SUBCELL_CORE_PIT
14) For the Active_Ind column, by default the value is set to "Y". To identify inactive records, compare data between IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HB_LOADER_SUBCELL_CORE_CURRENT and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_HB_LOADER_SUBCELL_CORE_STAGE. If a record is not found in the Current table, mark it as ‘N’ in the PIT view.
